batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2019-2020, Set-A — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.134-137 (questions on pp.134-137; printed answer table and printed worked solutions on p.137). The book prints this paper in two headed sections — 'Short Syllabus' (pp.134-135 and Q80 at the top of p.136) and 'Extra Syllabus' (p.136) — with Q71-75 and Q79 printed on p.137 above the answer table; questions are packed here in printed question-number order 1-80. Printed publisher answer keys preserved as-is; NOT official JU keys. All contentVerificationStatus=unverified pending cross-source verification. Q22: the printed answer table dual-keys (c, d) and the printed worked solution states both are correct with (d) the best answer — packed as multiple_choice with correctOptionIds [c, d]. Q28: the printed answer table shows a dash and the printed worked solution (book PDF p.137) explicitly states '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)' (no correct answer), giving ২ মাস, which is not among the options — packed with answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' and correctOptionIds []. The book prints no subject headings for this paper; subjects were assigned by content following the unit's standard structure (IQ 4, English 4, Bangla 4, Biology 44 = Zoology 22 + Botany 22, Chemistry 24); see the ANSWERS.md file for the assignment and its borderline cases (Q56, Q59). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-A of JU D Unit 2019-2020 occupies book PDF pp.134-137 (printed book pp.133-136): questions pp.134-137, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') on p.137 followed by printed worked solutions for selected questions — Short Syllabus: 06, 07, 14, 17, 21, 24, 25, 32, 34, 60, 76, 78 (Q78's worked solution is also printed at the top of p.136); Extra Syllabus: 22, 28, 48, 61. Every worked-solution key agrees with the answer table, including Q22 (solution confirms both (c) and (d) correct, (d) best) and Q28 (solution explicitly declares no correct answer). One wording anomaly: Q60's printed worked solution keys (d) as in the table, but its explanatory sentence speaks of the thermosphere having the highest temperature although the question asks for the lowest — flagged on the question, not resolved. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page with zoomed quadrant re-reads of all four pages and the answer table; chemical/mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, plain digits for subscripts).
